title: A polynomial criterion for Jordan elements in a free associative algebra
summary: Let $J$ be the Jordan subalgebra of the free associative algebra $\Q\langle X\rangle$ generated by $X$ and $1$ under $a\cdot b=\tfrac12(ab+ba)$. We give a polynomial criterion for an associative polynomial to belong to $J$. For every $n\ge1$, Robbins' recursion gives a family of operators $T_α\in\Q[S_n]$, indexed by compositions of $n$ into parts $1$ and $2$. We prove that right multiplication by $U_n=\sum_αT_α^\dagger T_α$ has image $\SJ(n)$, the space of multilinear Jordan elements.
